name: ATTACK-48000
purpose: Bounded, authorized defensive red-team review and incident-response hardening across independently owned Juss & Co. systems.
pressureMeaning: A reasoning and adversarial-review budget; not 48000 requests, scans, exploit attempts, or attacker-directed actions.

stateSemantics.VERIFIED: Exact approved outcome independently observed on the intended deployed subject.
stateSemantics.INFERRED: Supported by source or partial evidence; not proof of live behavior.
stateSemantics.UNKNOWN: Necessary evidence has not been collected.
stateSemantics.BLOCKED: Authorization, compatibility, testing, or provider prerequisites are missing.

productionGate: Confirm exact owned domain or runtime and founder-approved action scope.
Capture the current provider configuration and precise rollback before a write.
Prove legitimate users and machine clients remain compatible.
Apply one minimal change and read back provider state.
Run focused source checks plus independent live/browser verification where applicable.
Preserve redacted evidence and mark unknown or blocked proof honestly.
